payload.text: WP13 C11, a port bug the live parity found (hv's iTerm run): sync compares and keys email, phone and LinkedIn values as bytes, where the legacy's Swift sets and dictionaries compare by canonical equivalence, so sync --check and --check --json list extra people whose card holds a slug decomposed and whose About file holds it precomposed. Link, pull and photos dry runs are the same, the sandbox held, and the tree was unchanged. Fix: key and compare by normalise::decompose, displaying each original value; tests on synthetic values, red then green in a slot; landing on vc's go (asked, with sequencing against hv's push of b245b53). Then an opt build of C11, hv's iTerm re-run of the two check rows, and the sync rows into WP13's body.
